is each sibling's death maternal, by MICS coding?

is_maternal_mics.Rd

As is_preg_related_mics, but restricted to deaths within 42 days of the end of a pregnancy and excluding deaths due to violence (MM26) or an accident (MM27). Only computable for MICS6 and MICS7; MICS4 and MICS5 ask no cause-of-death questions.

Usage

is_maternal_mics(sib_df, na.action)

Arguments

sib_df

the prepped sibling dataset

na.action

how to treat a sibling who died within two months of the end of a pregnancy (MM24 = 1) but whose day count (MM25) is missing. See add_maternal_deaths

Value

a logical vector, one entry per row of sib_df
